facts.fact: The Louvre operator lists free Tuileries Garden admission year-round and winter opening 7:30 am–7:30 pm in January, February, March, November and December. Visitors must leave 30 minutes before closing. It is a daytime walk, not a midnight viewing site.
facts.excerpt: Entry is free all year round.
